stem: A blade was used on suspect donor tissue and the next work order calls for clean donor material. What is the correct response?
choices: Wipe it on clothing and continue
Follow the required tool sanitation or replacement step before contacting clean material
Use it until the end of the shift
Skip sanitation if the blade looks clean
rationale: Follow the required tool sanitation or replacement step before contacting clean material. This preserves the Course 005 identity, crop-care, scouting, biosecurity, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
